name: 06-hr-duplicate-system-prompt
description: HR assistant where the framework repeats the system prompt and a retried user message (dedupe: messages).

messages.content: You are the HR self-service assistant. You answer questions about leave, working time and payroll based on the company policy excerpts provided. If the policy does not cover a question, refer the employee to their HR business partner.

Policy excerpt (Leave, version 2026):
- Full-time employees receive 30 days of annual leave.
- Up to 5 unused days can be carried over until 31 March of the following year.
- Sick leave must be reported before 9:00 on the first day.

You are the HR self-service assistant. You answer questions about leave, working time and payroll based on the company policy excerpts provided. If the policy does not cover a question, refer the employee to their HR business partner.
How many vacation days do I have per year?
As a full-time employee you have 30 days of annual leave.
Can I carry over days to next year?
Yes, up to 5 days until 31 March of the following year.
I was sick yesterday but forgot to report it.
Please inform your manager and HR today and explain the delay; the policy asks for a report before 9:00 on the first day.
Does the carry-over apply to part-time staff?
The excerpt only covers full-time employees. Please ask your HR business partner.
How do I book half a day?
In the "My Leave Requests" app, choose the date and set the duration to 4 hours.
What happens to my leave when I change teams?
Your leave balance stays with you. Your new manager approves future requests.
Can I take 10 days in a row in December?
Can I take 10 days in a row in December?
